Has anyone on Voat ever been hired for a job solely by networking or from personal connections?

That is primarily how I have gotten where I am today, from connections with people I have worked with before. When I started my first business, my clients where initially from my network of professionals in that industry. Not only does the network potentially help finding a job, but placing you. Now be warned, this is a huge reputation opportunity that can fail quicker than you think. Personal referrals are high profile and the spotlight is shown on you. When a friend or connection vouches for you, they are also under scrutiny on how well you perform.
When you first started, did you find the network of professionals through school? Or did you have to actively reach out to the community somehow?

I could not afford to finish school and was lucky enough to be recruited by a large technology company. From my first job I started making connections. It was a junior level position, but I was able to prove myself quickly and rise through the ranks. I made connections along the way and as we moved through the industry, in different directions at times, they may be in a different part of the company or a different company completely and ping me as opportunities arose they felt I could contribute to. This has been a two way street, as I have also recruited connections to fit needs on my teams.

Keep in mind that doing a great job at work without a huge ego can be "networking" if the people around you are set up to notice. Networking doesn't have to be schmoozing.
